strings:
Written for Noctiluca's corpus, reduced from the general shape of a web
     search results page (not copied from any site): a sticky header with
     the logo as an inline <svg> and a search combobox holding the query;
     result-type tabs; results, each a site name and breadcrumb above a
     heading link and a snippet; a "People also ask" list of expandable
     questions (aria-expanded buttons with hidden answers); a knowledge
     panel beside the results; numbered pages at the foot. The results are
     what a terminal user wants first and fastest.
Tide tables for today and the next 7 days
High and low water times, heights and the moon's phase for every port on the coast. Updated daily at 06:00.
Tide Tables 2026 – Free printable tide charts
for 2026 as PDF or text, one page per month, with sunrise and sunset.
How do you read a tide table?
Each row gives a time and the water's height above chart datum.
What time is high tide today?
It depends on the port; the nearest is listed first.
Why are there two high tides a day?
The moon pulls the water on both sides of the earth.
